jython:import re

def standardize_flight(value):
    # Remove any alphabet characters before the flight number
    match = re.search(r'(\D+)-(\d+)', value)
    if match:
        return match.group(2)
    else:
        return value

# Apply the standardization function to each row in the dataset
flights = [
    "CO-1614-LAX-IAH",
    "UA-858-PVG-SFO",
    "AA-3804-PHL-ORD",
    "AA-3804-PHL-ORD",  # Duplicate entry, remove it later
    "UA-62-IAH-EWR",
    "AA-1733-ORD-PHX",
    "AA-1733-ORD-PHX",  # Duplicate entry, remove it later
    "AA-643-MIA-ORD",
    "UA-854-SFO-IAH",
    "UA-382-IAD-LAX",
    "UA-2830-MCO-CLT",
    "UA-938-DEN-ORD",
    "UA-2708-EWR-CLT",
    "AA-222-LAX-BOS",
    "AA-59-JFK-SFO",
    "AA-2268-PHX-ORD",
    "UA-854-SFO-IAH",
    "UA-37-EWR-MCO",
    "CO-58-DEN-IAH",
    "AA-1165-JFK-MIA"
]

# Remove duplicate entries
flights = list(set(flights))

# Standardize the flight codes
standardized_flights = [standardize_flight(flight) for flight in flights]

# Print the standardized flight codes
for flight in standardized_flights:
    print(flight)
return value

def standardize_airlines(value):
